maria: Quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sample app check-in. What I did / blockers / today:

aj: Done: patched sdk-js install logic to prefer wheels, opened PR #234. Blocker: mac M1 CI failing sporadically. Today: debug CI + land PR if green. :wrench:

sam: Done: updated sampleapp auth flow + README, added env var notes. Blocker: waiting on infra creds to run e2e. Today: add smoke test + rebase sampleapp branch.

lee: Docs update: published python quickstart v0.9. Noticed inconsistent casing on "Quick Start" vs "quickstart" across pages — will send a tiny style PR. Also added a short code snippet to embeddings page: `pip install redwood-inference==0.9.1`.

maria: Blocker for me: verify script fails on Windows due to path separators. Repro: run `scripts/verify.ps1` -> error: "Invalid path" on line 42.

sam: @aj @lee any chance infra can bless temporary creds? I can run e2e once I have them. :pray: @infra?

docs-bot: Created issue RW-456: "sampleapp: missing ENV docs" and linked sampleapp PR. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/456

aj: CI note: temporary env `USE_PIP_WHEEL=true` helps M1 runs. Will add to CI matrix for now, then revert after wheels publish. :thumbsup:

lee: Tiny nit: in quickstarts, some headings are H2 and some H3 for the same step. I'll normalize in my PR.

maria: Plan: pair with @aj at 11:30 to repro Windows verify, then push a fix for path handling. After that I will run the sampleapp smoke tests. If creds arrive earlier, @sam will run full e2e.

sam: Ack. I'll ping infra slack channel now. If anyone wants to join the pairing, drop a :hand: here.

aj: I can join pairing. Also will watch for CI green to merge PR.

maria: Thanks all — small day but focused. Leaving this thread open for quick updates.
